title: Maikura Coppersmith Tool
description: Copper oxidation, restoration and wax management tool for Minecraft builders.
body:
# Maikura Coppersmith Tool

A utility tool for working with copper blocks in survival building.

## Features

### Coppersmith Tool

- Oxidize copper blocks with right click
- Restore copper blocks with Shift + right click
- Toggle unwaxed copper highlighting

### Coppersmith Tool Kiwami

- Automatic waxing
- Wax storage system
- Honeycomb refills

## Supported Copper Blocks

- Copper Blocks
- Cut Copper
- Copper Doors
- Copper Trapdoors
- Copper Chains
- Waxed Variants

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric
